product.title: Flicker Eye Lashes - Rivaj HD
product.description:
Enhance your eyes with Flicker Eye Lashes. These stunning lashes are designed to provide dramatic length and volume, elevating your eye look to new heights. Crafted with high-quality synthetic fibers, these lashes are lightweight and comfortable to wear, ensuring a seamless and natural appearance. 

Highlights:

  • Dramatic Length and Volume
  • Lightweight and Comfortable
  • Easy Application
  • Vegan, latex-free lashes
  • Designed with a clear Flexi-band

How To Use:

1. Trim the eye lashes to fit the length of your natural lash line if necessary.
2. Apply a thin layer of lash adhesive along the lash band.
3. Allow the adhesive to become tacky for a few seconds.
4. Position the lashes as close to your natural lash line as possible and gently press them into place.
5. Hold for a few seconds to ensure proper adhesion.
6. Remove carefully by gently peeling the lashes off from the outer corner of your eye.
